$comment: IDD in-session enforcement — Claude Code hooks. Everything runs in-session: the PostToolUse hook runs the committed ast-grep checks against each edited file, and the PreToolUse hook is the commit gate — the same checks run over the tree and block `git commit` on failure. Failures feed back as exit-code-2 stderr with the check's message (constraint + rationale). Deterministic and local: no LLM, no network, no CI, no git hooks. Silent no-op when jq or ast-grep is missing or no checks are committed, so adopting IDD never breaks a repo.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'IDD mechanical check failed — fix before proposing this diff:\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml 2>&1) || { printf 'IDD commit gate: mechanical checks failed — fix before committing:\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
